title: Zesty Crisp Polish Fish Skillet
description: A winey and crisp Polish dish featuring Thai fish sauce, perfect for brunch, with a mother-sauce-base and sugar-free-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cod fish fillets to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8 minutes.
While the fish is cooking, mix the Thai fish sauce, white wine, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
After the fish is done, remove the skillet from the oven and pour the sauce mixture over the fish.
Return the skillet to the stovetop and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly and slightly reduced.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter until melted and serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
